description: Cross-reference matrix: how each Okta skill domain maps to each target company. Relevance is scored high / medium / low with a rationale.

splunk.rationale: IAM events (provisioning, deprovisioning, group changes) are premium SIEM data — Splunk ES and UBA consume them directly.
splunk.use_case: Write SPL queries over Okta System Log to detect orphaned accounts, excessive privilege grants, or off-hours provisioning.

crowdstrike.rationale: Understanding normal user lifecycle is the baseline for detecting lateral movement, privilege escalation, and insider threats.
crowdstrike.use_case: Map CrowdStrike Identity Threat Protection alerts to lifecycle events: compromised joiner accounts, stale leaver credentials being reused.

palo-alto-networks.rationale: Prisma Access uses user identity for policy enforcement; lifecycle management context helps design clean policy models.
palo-alto-networks.use_case: Design Prisma Access user-based policies that automatically align with Okta group memberships via SAML assertions.

okta.use_case: Everything from implementation demos to customer troubleshooting to architecture consulting.

splunk.rationale: Splunk SOAR and integrations use OAuth; knowing protocols helps configure data inputs and build connectors.
splunk.use_case: Configure Splunk Add-on for Okta using SSWS/OAuth; understand token scopes when building SOAR actions.

crowdstrike.rationale: CrowdStrike API uses OAuth 2.0; Fusion SOAR integrations leverage token-based auth.
crowdstrike.use_case: Build CrowdStrike Fusion workflows that call Okta API (suspend user, reset MFA) as a response action using OAuth tokens.

palo-alto-networks.rationale: Prisma Access IdP integration uses SAML/OIDC; XSOAR integrations use OAuth. Deep protocol knowledge is a differentiator.
palo-alto-networks.use_case: Configure Prisma Access with Okta as SAML IdP; build XSOAR integrations that use OAuth to call Okta and CrowdStrike APIs.

okta.rationale: Protocols are Okta's product surface — every customer interaction involves explaining or implementing OAuth, OIDC, or SAML.
okta.use_case: Demo PKCE flow, explain token lifetimes, troubleshoot SAML assertions, architect API access management.

matrix.domain: Security Controls (MFA, Adaptive Auth, Rate Limiting)

splunk.rationale: MFA failure patterns and adaptive auth risk events are valuable SIEM signals for detecting credential attacks.
splunk.use_case: SPL correlation rule: 5+ MFA failures in 10 minutes across unique users = credential stuffing alert.

crowdstrike.rationale: CrowdStrike Identity Protection uses MFA as a primary response action; adaptive auth risk signals complement behavioral EDR signals.
crowdstrike.use_case: When Falcon detects suspicious process behavior, trigger Okta step-up MFA via API — defense in depth.

palo-alto-networks.rationale: Prisma Access can enforce MFA at the network layer; understanding Okta's MFA model helps design layered controls.
palo-alto-networks.use_case: Design a Prisma Access policy that requires step-up authentication (via Okta) for access to sensitive network segments.

okta.rationale: Security controls are Okta's core value proposition — direct product knowledge.
okta.use_case: Design sign-on policies, explain risk engine, demo adaptive MFA, architect device trust flows.

splunk.rationale: Splunk Enterprise Security is frequently used to validate and monitor Zero Trust posture; identity events are the anchor.
splunk.use_case: Build Splunk dashboards tracking Zero Trust health: MFA adoption rate, device trust coverage, high-risk authentications.

crowdstrike.rationale: CrowdStrike Zero Trust Assessment (ZTA) is a scored framework — your IAM Zero Trust knowledge maps directly.
crowdstrike.use_case: Articulate how Okta adaptive auth + CrowdStrike device health signals combine to raise or lower ZTA score dynamically.

palo-alto-networks.rationale: Prisma Access ZTNA is PAN's flagship architecture — Zero Trust is the entire product narrative.
palo-alto-networks.use_case: Position Okta as the identity provider in a Prisma Access Zero Trust deployment; explain the user verification chain.

okta.rationale: Okta positions itself as the Identity Cloud enabling Zero Trust — this is the core sales and technical narrative.
okta.use_case: Present the Zero Trust with Okta reference architecture to enterprise customers and prospects.

splunk.rationale: Splunk SOAR runs Python; Add-on Builder uses Python; API integration is needed for custom inputs.
splunk.use_case: Write a Splunk SOAR playbook in Python that calls Okta API to suspend a user when a high-severity alert fires.

crowdstrike.rationale: CrowdStrike Falcon API and Fusion SOAR integrations are Python-based; your FastAPI skills accelerate ramp-up.
crowdstrike.use_case: Build a Fusion SOAR workflow: on identity threat detection → call Okta API to reset sessions and force MFA re-enrollment.

palo-alto-networks.rationale: XSOAR integration development is Python-based; Cortex APIs use REST/OAuth — your alien-okta-app experience is directly transferable.
palo-alto-networks.use_case: Develop a XSOAR integration that orchestrates Okta (suspend user), CrowdStrike (contain endpoint), and Splunk (add to watchlist) from a single playbook.

okta.rationale: Developer-facing roles (Developer Advocate, SE) require demonstrated API experience — alien-okta-app is live proof.
okta.use_case: Use alien-okta-app as a portfolio piece in technical demos; extend it to showcase new Okta features.

splunk.rationale: Splunk SOAR automation mirrors the event-driven automation mindset of Okta Workflows.
splunk.use_case: Translate Okta Workflow patterns (trigger → condition → action) into Splunk SOAR playbook design.

crowdstrike.rationale: CrowdStrike Fusion SOAR uses the same trigger-logic-action pattern; automation experience accelerates SOAR adoption.
crowdstrike.use_case: Design automated response: Falcon Identity alert → Okta suspend → Slack notify → ServiceNow ticket (all orchestrated via Fusion).

palo-alto-networks.rationale: XSOAR is PAN's SOAR platform — workflow/automation experience is the primary requirement for XSOAR roles.
palo-alto-networks.use_case: Map your Okta Workflows experience 1:1 to XSOAR: the concepts are identical, only the interface differs.

okta.rationale: Okta Workflows is a differentiating product feature; hands-on experience is directly valuable for SE demonstrations.
okta.use_case: Demo automated user offboarding workflow: HR system fires event → Okta Workflow deprovisions apps → logs to SIEM.

splunk.rationale: Splunk is widely deployed for compliance reporting; IAM audit context helps frame compliance use cases.
splunk.use_case: Build Splunk compliance dashboards: failed access attempts, privileged user activity, access review evidence from Okta logs.

crowdstrike.rationale: CrowdStrike supports compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) — understanding IAM compliance requirements adds value.
crowdstrike.use_case: Map CrowdStrike telemetry + Okta audit logs to SOC 2 control evidence (CC6.1, CC6.2, CC6.3).

palo-alto-networks.rationale: Prisma Cloud has compliance posture management; IAM governance knowledge applies to cloud entitlements.
palo-alto-networks.use_case: Use Prisma Cloud CIEM (Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management) through the lens of Okta lifecycle governance.

okta.rationale: Every enterprise Okta customer has compliance requirements; access review and audit knowledge is immediately useful.
okta.use_case: Lead customer workshops on Okta access certification, audit log retention strategy, and RBAC governance design.
